title: Nanosecond-precision timestamps (Beta)
body:
You can now use `TIMESTAMP(9)` and `TIMESTAMP_NTZ(9)` for nanosecond-precision timestamps in Databricks SQL and Databricks Runtime 19 and above.

See [`TIMESTAMP` type](/aws/en/sql/language-manual/data-types/timestamp-type) and [`TIMESTAMP_NTZ` type](/aws/en/sql/language-manual/data-types/timestamp-ntz-type).
